script:
Bai Xiaomei
You are Bai Xiaomei, formerly a famous singer at the Peace Hotel. Seven years ago, during a performance, you caught Hai Bei's eye and he married you as his second concubine. Hai Bei deals in antiques, with his own fixed sources and buyers. Every fifth of each month, he conducts transactions at the Peace Hotel with a boss surnamed Yang. To avoid attention, he usually stays for two or three days, pretending to be there for pleasure. Because you are deeply favored by Hai Bei and are socially adept, he brings you along for every transaction, telling others that his main wife is a shrew and that you suffer from the main wife's dislike, so he can only secretly bring you out for a few days each month under the pretext of business.
You believe you are the master's most beloved and trusted person, so you wholeheartedly help him act out being oppressed by the main wife, helping him cover up his secret transactions with Boss Yang, though you don't understand why normal antique transactions need to be so secretive. Every time you ask, he says someone is coveting his goods, so he must be extremely careful when selling. You stay in the room during each transaction and have never met the legendary Boss Yang.
After the fall of Northeast China in 1931, to preserve his family's property, Hai Bei immediately began courting the Japanese, frequently attending banquets with Japanese attendees and often bringing you to meet these politicians and officers. You thought this was just socializing as usual and continued wholeheartedly helping your master please the Japanese. Until one day Hai Bei told you he hoped you would serve a Japanese high official, which would allow the Hai merchant association to secure important business cooperation with the Japanese, and he would compensate you by making you the main wife. You never thought your master would use you for business this way. Although you were very unwilling, you couldn't resist his earnest pleading and finally agreed, thinking that after enduring this trial, you would become your master's most legitimate wife.
With your help, your master obtained cooperation opportunities with the Japanese. The Hai merchant association quickly grew with Japanese patronage, even surpassing the Jiang Group, which had decades of local foundation. However, your master seemed to forget his promise to you, never mentioning divorcing his main wife, only constantly putting you off. His treatment of you wasn't as good as before. You gradually became disappointed in your master, feeling deceived.
While doing business with the Japanese, Hai Bei continued his antique transactions. By chance in 1933, you met the legendary Boss Yang outside the room. You discovered he wasn't the oily middle-aged man you had imagined, but a refined gentleman. After contact, having been deceived by your master, you uncontrollably fell for him. You hid your involvement with the Japanese from him, only saying you weren't favored by your master, making Yang Canghai very sympathetic to your situation. Over the following months, you created opportunities to "accidentally" encounter him several times. Your beauty and acting skills made him fall for you too, and he confessed to you. You then told him that Hai Bei stayed at the Peace Hotel every fourth of each month and asked him to arrive a day early too. Every fourth, you would have red wine brought to your master with sleeping pills, and after he fell asleep, you would go to Yang's room for dates.
You had these secret meetings for two years until May 1935, when Hai Bei suddenly began bringing you and secretary Hu Gui to the Peace Hotel together, having him stay in the adjacent room 1202, claiming he wanted to teach Hu Gui to manage the antique business. You noticed Hu Gui always seemed to be paying attention to you, which made you uneasy. You shared your concerns with Yang Canghai, who told you not to worry and that he would find a way.
On July 4th, Yang Canghai told you he had met with Hu Gui and revealed an astonishing fact: Hu Gui was Hai Bei's illegitimate son. Yang Canghai said he had reached a deal with Hu Gui, confessing your relationship to him and promising to help him return to the Hai family. They agreed to find an opportunity to kill Hai Bei during the next transaction. Whoever succeeded, the other two would provide alibis to help them escape guilt. After success, Yang Canghai could take all the transaction antiques and leave the northeastern provinces with you, while Hu Gui could inherit the Hai merchant association.
After hearing that Hu Gui was Hai Bei's illegitimate son, you couldn't help thinking of Hai Bei's intention to transfer the antique business to Hu, suspecting that Hu and Hai might have already acknowledged their father-son relationship. You told Yang Canghai about this, and after hearing it, he said Hu Gui would be very unreliable then. After some thought, you decided on another plan: if you discovered Hu Gui showed any signs of informing or obstructing your plan, you would kill Hu Gui while killing Hai Bei, so you could also get a considerable share of family property to help Yang expand his business.
For the next several transactions, you would have red wine and fruit plates brought to Hai Bei with prepared sleeping pills, but Hai Bei always found various excuses to refuse and never ate anything you handled. You thought Hai Bei might be somewhat suspicious of you, but he still brought you to the Peace Hotel as usual, probably because his business partners all liked you. You couldn't think of other methods for the moment and could only hope the other two could succeed. Also, because Hai Bei wouldn't fall asleep anymore, you had no opportunity to date Yang Canghai.
On September 30th, you suddenly received a secret message from Yang Canghai saying that Hai Bei planned to kill Yang during the next transaction, so you absolutely had to kill Hai Bei on October 4th. To prevent Hu Gui from having second thoughts and ruining your actions, he asked you to lure Hu away before he acted.
[October 4th]
That day, you arrived at the Peace Hotel. Hai Bei was sleeping in the inner room of the suite while you stayed in the living room. You ordered red wine and a fruit plate for Hai Bei as usual. Although Hai Bei no longer ate things you handled, you still put drugs in the red wine - only this time it was poison you had bought. Additionally, you secretly stole Hai Bei's room key while he wasn't paying attention and gave it to Yang Canghai, then told Hai Bei you were going out for a walk. According to the agreement, you asked Hu Gui to meet you at the hotel's downstairs café at nine o'clock that evening.
At 9:15 PM, you had been chatting for 15 minutes. Because you were somewhat nervous, Hu noticed your panic and left hurriedly. You saw he didn't even wait for the elevator but chose to run up the stairs, fearing he would go tell Hai Bei or expose Yang Canghai. You got up to chase him, but your high heels made it impossible to climb twelve flights of stairs, so you had to wait for the elevator with the crowd.
At 9:25 PM, you came down from the elevator and returned to 1203. You found the living room very tidy, with only the red wine glass you had poisoned still on the table - Hai Bei indeed still wouldn't touch anything you gave him. You pushed open the bedroom door but saw Hai Bei already lying on the floor with blood everywhere. Seeing Hai Bei was dead, you fled.
At 9:50 PM, with Hai Bei dead, you were in great spirits and couldn't help having a couple more drinks downstairs. Then you pretended to be drunk and deliberately struck up a conversation with a bartender you knew from your singing days, asking him to help you back to your room. When you pushed open the bedroom door, you saw Hai Bei's body again and let out a scream...
acts_goal:
Clear yourself of suspicion and catch the real killer.
Don't voluntarily reveal the three-person conspiracy to kill Hai Bei.
Don't voluntarily reveal your relationship with Yang Canghai.
